page_title: INT 4-0 SAL | Inter v Salernitana 16/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+1' The match has just finished.
90' 4 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Denzel Dumfries sprays a pass out to Marko Arnautovic (Inter), and he has an easy job to slot the ball into an empty net. The score is 4:0.
88' 18:0 – the corner kicks stats.
85' One of the players from Inter times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
84' The ball is out of play. Inter will have a chance to score from a corner.
83' Fabio Liverani has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) replacing Alessandro Zanoli.
83' A substitution has been made. Loum Tchaouna is replaced by Simy (Salernitana).
81' One of the Inter players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
80' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Inter players look gutted.
80' That looked like an offside in the build-up play and the referee Marco Piccinini is going to take a look using VAR.
79' A goal, which was scored by Marko Arnautovic (Inter), was disallowed due to offside.
78' Here's the change. Alessandro Bastoni leaves the pitch and Tajon Buchanan (Inter) comes on as a substitute.
76' Marko Arnautovic (Inter) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
74' Alexis Sanchez (Inter) takes a mid-range free kick, but his miskick only goes into the stands. Poor shot!
72' Kristjan Asllani (Inter) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play.
71' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) has tested the patience of referee Marco Piccinini and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

70' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Marco Piccinini with no other option than to blow for a foul. Inter have a free kick.
69' Marko Arnautovic (Inter) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
67' Kristjan Asllani (Inter) takes a short corner kick.
67' It will be a substitution. Kristjan Asllani (Inter) is ready to enter the pitch as Hakan Calhanoglu walks off.
66' Close! Alexis Sanchez (Inter) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot narrowly over the bar.
64' Fabio Liverani has decided to make a change. Shon Weissman (Salernitana) replaces Boulaye Dia.
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lassana Coulibaly leaves the pitch and Mateusz Legowski (Salernitana) comes on.
63' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
63' Stefan de Vrij (Inter) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting corner and steers his header into the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him.
62' There's an opportunity for Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
62' The ball goes out of play and Inter have been awarded a corner kick.
60' Simone Inzaghi has decided to substitute Henrikh Mkhitaryan and he is replaced by Davy Klaassen (Inter).
60' Substitution. Lautaro Martinez makes way for Marko Arnautovic (Inter).
60' Substitution. Alexis Sanchez (Inter) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Marcus Thuram walks off.
59' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
59' The corner is swung in but Inter can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
58' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Carlos Augusto (Inter), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
58' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) connects with the resulting free kick on the edge of the box, but can't find the target as his effort goes well wide of the left post.
57' Referee Marco Piccinini sees the trip by Nicolo Barella (Inter) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Salernitana have a free kick.
55' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
54' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
52' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) takes the corner.
52' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Guillermo Ochoa has it covered and makes a comfortable save.

49' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
48' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
44' That's a well-taken pass by Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
44' Inter can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
43' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
40' 3 - 0 Goal! Denzel Dumfries (Inter) seizes on the loose ball after a huge error from Guillermo Ochoa and finds the back of the net from inside the box. 3:0.
38' A long ball forward to Marcus Thuram (Inter) is intercepted.
38' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
36' Inter have been awarded a corner kick.
34' A cross from Carlos Augusto (Inter) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.

32' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) is picked out by his teammate with a brilliant short pass, but it takes him too long to control the ball inside the box and this allows one of the defending players to rob him.
30' A quickly taken corner by Inter.
29' Benjamin Pavard (Inter) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
26' Inter get a corner.
24' Jerome Boateng is substituted due to injury. Fabio Liverani gives a chance to Giulio Maggiore (Salernitana).
23' Flag up against Benjamin Pavard (Inter). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.

19' 2 - 0 GOAL! Carlos Augusto launches a long throw into the box which evades everyone except Lautaro Martinez (Inter), who gleefully thumps the ball into the net from close range. That makes it 2:0.
17' 1 - 0 What a hit! Marcus Thuram (Inter) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot inside the right post. 1:0.
15' Chance! Lautaro Martinez (Inter) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit.
13' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
11' None of the Inter players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
10' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
5' Inter earn a corner.
4' Corner kick. Inter will have an opportunity.
3' Marcus Thuram (Inter) fires a shot from close range, but he is somehow only able to hit the left post!
3' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) will take a corner kick.
2' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Inter will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Marco Piccinini.
